findings: OnUpView best_parent branch sets selected_parent but leaves parents empty, then gates activation on parents. Valid best_parent is ignored and no-parents status displayed; reproduced.
OnShallowerView expression max_depth_seen or 0 - 1 leaves positive max_depth_seen unchanged on first invocation. Seen5 produces limit5, not4; reproduced.
SetPercentageView dereferences loader without checking initial no-profile state. Percentage denominator comes from root adapter value, not selected subtree. Static finding.
SourceShowFile reads live local source rather than captured profile source and does not update sourceFileShown after successful read. Source/measurement correspondence unqualified.
All Callees/All Callers tabs are created but update calls are commented out. UI labels do not prove transitive relation coverage. Static finding.

SetModel passes rows.values() to DataView.integrateRecords, which slices functions[:]; Python3 dict view would not support this even after syntax port. Current original module fails Python2 syntax and legacy imports.
OnCloseWindow writes config to suffix~ then rename, but does not explicitly close/flush handle before replacement; no config path written in review.
Column definitions shared among controls receive mutable index values; load error handlers cover selected exception types only. No runtime or app compatibility claim, no production code copied.
